TA0025.title: Gold Farming Studios
TA0025.description: Gold farming studios are service organizations or individuals that provide virtual currencies, game items, and other virtual wealth. Their main business is providing in-game virtual currency, items, and characters to players through professional players or automated scripts in exchange for real money.

TA0025-001.title: In-Game Currency Dealer
TA0025-001.description: Individuals who sell in-game points or gold coins, typically acquired in bulk through various in-game methods, and resell them to other players at prices below the official rate. This behavior can negatively impact the game economy, disrupt balance, and degrade other players' experience. Game operators typically counter this with account bans and enhanced security detection.

TA0025-002.title: Game Boosters
TA0025-002.description: Game boosters are professional players or teams who play games on behalf of other players, providing boosting services. This service typically involves helping other players level up game characters, obtain virtual items, and complete specific tasks or challenges. Game boosters usually have extensive game experience and skills to quickly and efficiently complete tasks.

TA0025-003.title: Match Fixers
TA0025-003.description: Generally refers to players in games who engage in score-giving and score-taking behavior, manipulating match results within the same game session. This malicious behavior generally appears in MOBA game matches and sometimes in FPS games.
